name: Saginomiya
tagline: Shinjuku in 25 minutes and Shibuya in 34 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Nakano City, where Seibu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 34 minutes to Shibuya and 55 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 38 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 38 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 38 m to 43.1 m, a difference of 5.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 16 clinics and 17 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is つるた鷺ノ宮クリニック, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 薄病院, about 11 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Seibu Shinjuku Line.
congestion: Seibu Shinjuku Line runs at 148% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 下落合→高田馬場, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Toritsu-Kasei is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Saginomiya.

neighbours.lead: Nogata is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Saginomiya is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 3 minutes sooner than Saginomiya. One-room rents run about ¥8,000 lower.

noiseSources: 中杉通り (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Seibu Shinjuku Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
